create_hsv_to_rgb: create a function that converts an HSV color tuple to an RGB tuple with values scaled to 0-255
run_hsv_to_rgb: run the hsv_to_rgb function with an HSV tuple like (0.5, 1.0, 1.0) and return the resulting RGB tuple
test_hsv_to_rgb: test the hsv_to_rgb function with known HSV inputs and verify the RGB output matches expected values
refactor_hsv_to_rgb: refactor the hsv_to_rgb function to accept numpy arrays in addition to tuples as input
review_hsv_to_rgb: review the hsv_to_rgb function for correctness when converting HSV color space to RGB color space
